scope: Freeze semantic family separately from exact primary execution checker and solution consumer set (I02/I07/I08).

inherited owners for the same source

stateVariables.scenario: Fixed selections, component membership and trusted requirements; external checker internals excluded.
stateVariables.pending,seen: Arrival order and union of semantic requirements.
stateVariables.frozen,family: Authority snapshot vs current family after coloring.
stateVariables.owner,solution: Single source owner, separate checker set for nested or empty solution.
stateVariables.phase: Evidence, freeze, selection, manifest or rejection.

initialState: Pending evidence in unspecified delivery order; no owner published.
assumptions: One representative source, a fixed sibling for shared solution, a same-family tsc/tsgo conflict on an equality component. Empty solution can coexist with unrelated source. No Svelte declaration capability.

safety.ExactComponent: Same semantic family is not exact execution identity.
safety.SourceOwner: Admitted source has a primary checker.
safety.SolutionConsumers: Solution collects checkers of member sources only.
safety.LegalCases: The legal examples must not be refused.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: 4 or 7 scenarios, up to two independent pending requirements.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: Last-wins is not convergence. Shared solution is not a conflicting primary owner.
empiricalVerification: Run generated-graph.spec.ts (reverse import order, nested shared/empty solutions) and typecheck.spec.ts (inherited owners); compare real checker diagnostics separately.
